build_parser_hermes_cli: build an argparse parser replica of the hermes top-level CLI with subparsers for chat, model, gateway, and setup
test_safe_parse_defensive_routing: test the defensive subparser routing workaround that handles argparse SystemExit fallback on required=True
test_safe_parse_with_subcommand: test _safe_parse with a known subcommand token like 'chat' to verify deterministic routing
test_safe_parse_with_flag_value: test _safe_parse with --continue consuming a subcommand name as its value to verify fallback behavior
test_safe_parse_without_subcommand: test _safe_parse with no subcommand token to verify required=False default path
